ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, LDGCRM_Email__c, LDGCRM_External_ID__c, LDGCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Team_Name__c, LDGCRM_P3_Team_UUID__c, LGDCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Admin__c, LDGCRM_contact__r.Name, LDGCRM_Application__r.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM LDGCRM_Application_Contact__c WHERE LGDCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Admin__c = TRUE AND LDGCRM_P3_Team_UUID__c = :teamuuid ORDER BY Name DESC
ApiNamedQuery.description: Login.gov Partnership Portal Integration. Partner Portal ADMINS for one team, which is the portal's main lookup. The admin flag is hardcoded TRUE, not a parameter, so this cannot accidentally return non-admins; use ...ByTeamUuid for a team's whole roster.
ApiNamedQuery.masterLabel: Login.gov Application Contacts - Partner Admin By Team UUID

apiNamedQueryParameters.description: The Partner Portal team UUID to match exactly.
